arrays.bulk_cg_m3: canopy bulk density, hundredths of kg/m3

source: Meta & WRI global canopy height (Tolan et al. 2024), ~1.2 m, imagery mostly 2018-2020, https://dataforgood-fb-data.s3.amazonaws.com/forests/v1/alsgedi_global_v6_float; resampled to 2 m (average) and aggregated by hindcast/canopy_open.py
method: as canopy.py (canopy.layers_from_chm): cover = share of 2 m pixels >= 4 m, height = their 90th percentile, base and bulk density assumed per COS class
caveat: a model of satellite imagery (MAE 2.8 m), not a measurement; its year is not the fire's
